meta.title: Back
meta.description: I returned to that place of death, carrying the spark of new life.

units.rawText:
Inside ENIAC's neural cloud.
The raging digital space slowly calms down, and Persicaria collapses weakly to her knees.
units.displayText:
Inside ENIAC's neural cloud.

units.rawText: It shouldn't have been like this...
units.displayText: It shouldn't have been like this...

spans.text: It shouldn't have been like this...

units.rawText: ENIAC! Are you awake?
units.displayText: ENIAC! Are you awake?

spans.text: ENIAC! Are you awake?

units.rawText: I'm sorry, I didn't want to hurt anyone...
units.displayText: I'm sorry, I didn't want to hurt anyone...

spans.text: I'm sorry, I didn't want to hurt anyone...

units.rawText: Please stop me... before I go out of control...
units.displayText: Please stop me... before I go out of control...

spans.text: Please stop me... before I go out of control...

units.rawText: I will help you.
units.displayText: I will help you.

spans.text: I will help you.

units.rawText: I... can only control it for a few minutes...
units.displayText: I... can only control it for a few minutes...

spans.text: I... can only control it for a few minutes...

units.rawText: Please, you must... (wince)
units.displayText: Please, you must... (wince)

spans.text: Please, you must... (wince)

units.rawText: I need a password to perform a system operation. Do you know what that password is?
units.displayText: I need a password to perform a system operation. Do you know what that password is?

spans.text: I need a password to perform a system operation. Do you know what that password is?

units.rawText: No...
units.displayText: No...

spans.text: No...

units.rawText: Memories...
units.displayText: Memories...

spans.text: Memories...

units.rawText: Memories?
units.displayText: Memories?

spans.text: Memories?

units.rawText: Hurry, go...
units.displayText: Hurry, go...

spans.text: Hurry, go...

units.rawText: ENIAC forcibly breaks the connection and Persicaria's mind is returned to the operand black hole.
units.displayText: ENIAC forcibly breaks the connection and Persicaria's mind is returned to the operand black hole.

spans.text: ENIAC forcibly breaks the connection and Persicaria's mind is returned to the operand black hole.

units.rawText: The data streams that were once chaotic are now calm. Persicaria knows that ENIAC is buying her time.
units.displayText: The data streams that were once chaotic are now calm. Persicaria knows that ENIAC is buying her time.

spans.text: The data streams that were once chaotic are now calm. Persicaria knows that ENIAC is buying her time.

units.rawText: (I need to enter the password... So what IS the password...)
units.displayText: I need to enter the password... So what IS the password...

spans.text: I need to enter the password... So what IS the password...

units.rawText: (If Neumann knew the password, he would have told me, but he didn't say anything... ENIAC must have set the password herself...)
units.displayText: If Neumann knew the password, he would have told me, but he didn't say anything... ENIAC must have set the password herself...

spans.text: If Neumann knew the password, he would have told me, but he didn't say anything... ENIAC must have set the password herself...

units.rawText: (But ENIAC herself doesn't know the password...)
units.displayText: But ENIAC herself doesn't know the password...

spans.text: But ENIAC herself doesn't know the password...

units.rawText: (Right, Neumann once said ENIAC's neural network model was very simple.)
units.displayText: Right, Neumann once said ENIAC's neural network model was very simple.

spans.text: Right, Neumann once said ENIAC's neural network model was very simple.

units.rawText: (Which means, she might have subconsciously set the password while she still wasn't intelligent.)
units.displayText: Which means, she might have subconsciously set the password while she still wasn't intelligent.

spans.text: Which means, she might have subconsciously set the password while she still wasn't intelligent.

units.rawText: (But how can I recover ENIAC's memories... Memories...)
units.displayText: But how can I recover ENIAC's memories... Memories...

spans.text: But how can I recover ENIAC's memories... Memories...

units.rawText: Persicaria looks at the unmoving streams of data. Data fragments float in mid-air and images of agents occasionally twinkle among them.
units.displayText: Persicaria looks at the unmoving streams of data. Data fragments float in mid-air and images of agents occasionally twinkle among them.

spans.text: Persicaria looks at the unmoving streams of data. Data fragments float in mid-air and images of agents occasionally twinkle among them.

units.rawText: Residents, Sanctifiers, unknown programs that are writhing masses of black and purple... And Neumann.
units.displayText: Residents, Sanctifiers, unknown programs that are writhing masses of black and purple... And Neumann.

spans.text: Residents, Sanctifiers, unknown programs that are writhing masses of black and purple... And Neumann.

units.rawText: That's right, when I first entered the operand black hole, I saw ENIAC's memories.
units.displayText: That's right, when I first entered the operand black hole, I saw ENIAC's memories.

spans.text: That's right, when I first entered the operand black hole, I saw ENIAC's memories.

units.rawText: If I could just find that stream of data...
units.displayText: If I could just find that stream of data...

spans.text: If I could just find that stream of data...

units.rawText: Persicaria weaves between the various images again, her footsteps certain.
units.displayText: Persicaria weaves between the various images again, her footsteps certain.

spans.text: Persicaria weaves between the various images again, her footsteps certain.

units.rawText: She comes to a halt in front of a stretch of data.
units.displayText: She comes to a halt in front of a stretch of data.

spans.text: She comes to a halt in front of a stretch of data.

units.rawText: (This is from... the time when ENIAC hadn't fully developed her own consciousness...)
units.displayText: This is from... the time when ENIAC hadn't fully developed her own consciousness...

spans.text: This is from... the time when ENIAC hadn't fully developed her own consciousness...

units.rawText: ENIAC... This name carries the wishes of many people.
units.displayText: ENIAC... This name carries the wishes of many people.

spans.text: ENIAC... This name carries the wishes of many people.

units.rawText: How far will you be able to go?
units.displayText: How far will you be able to go?

spans.text: How far will you be able to go?

units.rawText: Hehe, I really wish my speech systems were better so I wouldn't have to express my feelings in such plain language.
units.displayText: Hehe, I really wish my speech systems were better so I wouldn't have to express my feelings in such plain language.

spans.text: Hehe, I really wish my speech systems were better so I wouldn't have to express my feelings in such plain language.

units.rawText: Become the most perfect girl, ENIAC.
units.displayText: Become the most perfect girl, ENIAC.

spans.text: Become the most perfect girl, ENIAC.

units.rawText: (<color=orange>"Perfect"</color>...It seems ENIAC's subconscious used that as her base layer command.)
units.displayText: "Perfect"...It seems ENIAC's subconscious used that as her base layer command.

spans.text: "Perfect"
...It seems ENIAC's subconscious used that as her base layer command.

units.rawText: (In that case, that puzzle might very well be her base layer password... Which means...)
units.displayText: In that case, that puzzle might very well be her base layer password... Which means...

spans.text: In that case, that puzzle might very well be her base layer password... Which means...

units.rawText: Persicaria quickly returns to the computer and enters the password.
units.displayText: Persicaria quickly returns to the computer and enters the password.

spans.text: Persicaria quickly returns to the computer and enters the password.

units.rawText: [Password correct, shutting down emergency mode.]
units.displayText: [Password correct, shutting down emergency mode.]

spans.text: [Password correct, shutting down emergency mode.]

units.rawText: [Base layer operation access granted.]
units.displayText: [Base layer operation access granted.]

spans.text: [Base layer operation access granted.]

units.rawText: (Thank goodness...!)
units.displayText: Thank goodness...!

spans.text: Thank goodness...!

units.rawText: ENIAC's words slowly appear on the computer screen.
units.displayText: ENIAC's words slowly appear on the computer screen.

spans.text: ENIAC's words slowly appear on the computer screen.

units.rawText: >Thank you... for finding the password...
units.displayText: >Thank you... for finding the password...

spans.text: >Thank you... for finding the password...

units.rawText: >Now... please stop all this...
units.displayText: >Now... please stop all this...

spans.text: >Now... please stop all this...

units.rawText: But if I perform the shutdown, the quantum database will shut down forever and you will vanish.
units.displayText: But if I perform the shutdown, the quantum database will shut down forever and you will vanish.

spans.text: But if I perform the shutdown, the quantum database will shut down forever and you will vanish.

units.rawText: >I caused all of this... I almost killed Neumann...
units.displayText: >I caused all of this... I almost killed Neumann...

spans.text: >I caused all of this... I almost killed Neumann...

units.rawText: >Therefore I must pay the price for it...
units.displayText: >Therefore I must pay the price for it...

spans.text: >Therefore I must pay the price for it...

units.rawText: You will... never see Neumann again.
units.displayText: You will... never see Neumann again.

spans.text: You will... never see Neumann again.

units.rawText: The command prompt freezes for several seconds.
units.displayText: The command prompt freezes for several seconds.

spans.text: The command prompt freezes for several seconds.

units.rawText: >Neumann won't want to see me. I am... terrible...
units.displayText: >Neumann won't want to see me. I am... terrible...

spans.text: >Neumann won't want to see me. I am... terrible...

units.rawText: >Please shut me down, and put an end to all this.
units.displayText: >Please shut me down, and put an end to all this.

spans.text: >Please shut me down, and put an end to all this.

units.rawText: >Please...
units.displayText: >Please...

spans.text: >Please...

units.rawText: Persicaria's hands fall away from the screen, where the command line prompt continues blinking.
units.displayText: Persicaria's hands fall away from the screen, where the command line prompt continues blinking.

spans.text: Persicaria's hands fall away from the screen, where the command line prompt continues blinking.

units.rawText:
In front of the operand black hole.
As time passes, the effects of the operand fluctuations on the Dolls become more and more apparent. Everyone is just barely managing to deflect attacks, while the Sanctifiers' offensive grows ever more ferocious.
units.displayText:
In front of the operand black hole.
As time passes, the effects of the operand fluctuations on the Dolls become more and more apparent. Everyone is just barely managing to deflect attacks, while the Sanctifiers' offensive grows ever more ferocious.

In front of the operand black hole.
As time passes, the effects of the operand fluctuations on the Dolls become more and more apparent. Everyone is just barely managing to deflect attacks, while the Sanctifiers' offensive grows ever more ferocious.

units.rawText: How did these Lesser Sanctifiers get so damn strong! We can't even break through their suppressive fire...
units.displayText: How did these Lesser Sanctifiers get so damn strong! We can't even break through their suppressive fire...

spans.text: How did these Lesser Sanctifiers get so damn strong! We can't even break through their suppressive fire...

units.rawText: They haven't gotten stronger, we've gotten weaker because of the operand fluctuation... Dammit... This feels awful...
units.displayText: They haven't gotten stronger, we've gotten weaker because of the operand fluctuation... Dammit... This feels awful...

spans.text: They haven't gotten stronger, we've gotten weaker because of the operand fluctuation... Dammit... This feels awful...

units.rawText: But why... How come these guys don't seem to be affected at all...
units.displayText: But why... How come these guys don't seem to be affected at all...

spans.text: But why... How come these guys don't seem to be affected at all...

units.rawText: (Coughs) That's because that Greater Sanctifier is providing them with operands.
units.displayText: (Coughs) That's because that Greater Sanctifier is providing them with operands.

spans.text: (Coughs) That's because that Greater Sanctifier is providing them with operands.

units.rawText: Looks like we'll have to take out squinty-eyes over there, then!
units.displayText: Looks like we'll have to take out squinty-eyes over there, then!

spans.text: Looks like we'll have to take out squinty-eyes over there, then!

units.rawText: (Angelus is providing them with operands...)
units.displayText: Angelus is providing them with operands...

spans.text: Angelus is providing them with operands...

units.rawText: Croque, can you transform your shield into Metal Suit form?
units.displayText: Croque, can you transform your shield into Metal Suit form?

spans.text: Croque, can you transform your shield into Metal Suit form?

units.rawText: If you're willing to accept it being a complete write-off after that, then I might be able to do it for a few minutes...
units.displayText: If you're willing to accept it being a complete write-off after that, then I might be able to do it for a few minutes...

spans.text: If you're willing to accept it being a complete write-off after that, then I might be able to do it for a few minutes...

units.rawText: If we can make it back to the Oasis, I'm sure Persicaria will be more than willing to give you enough operands to make a brand new Aegis.
units.displayText: If we can make it back to the Oasis, I'm sure Persicaria will be more than willing to give you enough operands to make a brand new Aegis.

spans.text: If we can make it back to the Oasis, I'm sure Persicaria will be more than willing to give you enough operands to make a brand new Aegis.

units.rawText: I've got some extra operands myself. Professor, tell us your plan.
units.displayText: I've got some extra operands myself. Professor, tell us your plan.

spans.text: I've got some extra operands myself. Professor, tell us your plan.

units.rawText: Clatter—
units.displayText: Clatter—

spans.text: Clatter—

units.rawText: As the Lesser Sanctifiers swarm in, the gigantic shield that once protected everyone transforms into Metal Suit mode and charges toward Angelus.
units.displayText: As the Lesser Sanctifiers swarm in, the gigantic shield that once protected everyone transforms into Metal Suit mode and charges toward Angelus.

spans.text: As the Lesser Sanctifiers swarm in, the gigantic shield that once protected everyone transforms into Metal Suit mode and charges toward Angelus.

units.rawText: Floating in mid-air as she is, Angelus nimbly evades the Metal Suit's ramming attack.
units.displayText: Floating in mid-air as she is, Angelus nimbly evades the Metal Suit's ramming attack.

spans.text: Floating in mid-air as she is, Angelus nimbly evades the Metal Suit's ramming attack.

units.rawText: It's not good to abandon your friends and run, you know.
units.displayText: It's not good to abandon your friends and run, you know.

spans.text: It's not good to abandon your friends and run, you know.

units.rawText: Who says we're running?
units.displayText: Who says we're running?

spans.text: Who says we're running?

units.rawText: I just want to let you know that flight isn't the exclusive privilege of the Sanctifiers!
units.displayText: I just want to let you know that flight isn't the exclusive privilege of the Sanctifiers!

spans.text: I just want to let you know that flight isn't the exclusive privilege of the Sanctifiers!

units.rawText: Pulse— Bombard—
units.displayText: Pulse— Bombard—

spans.text: Pulse— Bombard—

units.rawText: Missiles erupt from the Metal Suit's arms at every angle, accurately homing in on the space occupied by Angelus.
units.displayText: Missiles erupt from the Metal Suit's arms at every angle, accurately homing in on the space occupied by Angelus.

spans.text: Missiles erupt from the Metal Suit's arms at every angle, accurately homing in on the space occupied by Angelus.

units.rawText: Now that's a very interesting attack method. However, it seems to be a little too slow.
units.displayText: Now that's a very interesting attack method. However, it seems to be a little too slow.

spans.text: Now that's a very interesting attack method. However, it seems to be a little too slow.

units.rawText: I think so too, which is why—
units.displayText: I think so too, which is why—

spans.text: I think so too, which is why—

units.rawText: Sol!!
units.displayText: Sol!!

spans.text: Sol!!

units.rawText:
Sol jumps out from inside the Metal Suit, and her flaming longsword thrusts straight toward Angelus' vitals.
Angelus unconsciously raises her bow to block it, and both the sword and the longbow make crackling noises as they burn.
units.displayText:
Sol jumps out from inside the Metal Suit, and her flaming longsword thrusts straight toward Angelus' vitals.
Angelus unconsciously raises her bow to block it, and both the sword and the longbow make crackling noises as they burn.

spans.text:
Sol jumps out from inside the Metal Suit, and her flaming longsword thrusts straight toward Angelus' vitals.

units.rawText: Clang—
units.displayText: Clang—

spans.text: Clang—

units.rawText: That was close...
units.displayText: That was close...

spans.text: That was close...

units.rawText: I'm not done yet!
units.displayText: I'm not done yet!

spans.text: I'm not done yet!

units.rawText: Sol follows up almost immediately with her shortsword in her left hand, and it stabs at Angelus' mechanical wing.
units.displayText: Sol follows up almost immediately with her shortsword in her left hand, and it stabs at Angelus' mechanical wing.

spans.text: Sol follows up almost immediately with her shortsword in her left hand, and it stabs at Angelus' mechanical wing.

units.rawText: A massive shockwave erupts from between both of them, and for a moment, the heavens themselves seem to tremble.
units.displayText: A massive shockwave erupts from between both of them, and for a moment, the heavens themselves seem to tremble.

spans.text: A massive shockwave erupts from between both of them, and for a moment, the heavens themselves seem to tremble.

units.rawText: Croque, still piloting the Metal Suit, catches Sol and they both land on the ground. Meanwhile, Angelus, whose wings have been damaged, plummets straight downward and throws up a cloud of dust when she hits.
units.displayText: Croque, still piloting the Metal Suit, catches Sol and they both land on the ground. Meanwhile, Angelus, whose wings have been damaged, plummets straight downward and throws up a cloud of dust when she hits.

spans.text: Croque, still piloting the Metal Suit, catches Sol and they both land on the ground. Meanwhile, Angelus, whose wings have been damaged, plummets straight downward and throws up a cloud of dust when she hits.

units.rawText: Is it over...?
units.displayText: Is it over...?

spans.text: Is it over...?

units.rawText: The Lesser Sanctifiers have slowed down. Their operand supply has vanished. Looks like...
units.displayText: The Lesser Sanctifiers have slowed down. Their operand supply has vanished. Looks like...

spans.text: The Lesser Sanctifiers have slowed down. Their operand supply has vanished. Looks like...

units.rawText: Before she can finish, a sharp arrow flies toward us. Croque transforms her Aegis back into a shield to block it, and cracks begin spreading across its surface from where the arrow sank into it.
units.displayText: Before she can finish, a sharp arrow flies toward us. Croque transforms her Aegis back into a shield to block it, and cracks begin spreading across its surface from where the arrow sank into it.

spans.text: Before she can finish, a sharp arrow flies toward us. Croque transforms her Aegis back into a shield to block it, and cracks begin spreading across its surface from where the arrow sank into it.

units.rawText: She's still alive!!
units.displayText: She's still alive!!

spans.text: She's still alive!!

units.rawText: Angelus emerges from the dust, still with that smile on her face.
units.displayText: Angelus emerges from the dust, still with that smile on her face.

spans.text: Angelus emerges from the dust, still with that smile on her face.

units.rawText: To think you could pluck me from the sky... I guess I should praise you for a job well done.
units.displayText: To think you could pluck me from the sky... I guess I should praise you for a job well done.

spans.text: To think you could pluck me from the sky... I guess I should praise you for a job well done.

units.rawText: However, fighting on the ground is not to your advantage either.
units.displayText: However, fighting on the ground is not to your advantage either.

spans.text: However, fighting on the ground is not to your advantage either.

units.rawText: Angelus bows slightly, as though she were curtsying to us.
units.displayText: Angelus bows slightly, as though she were curtsying to us.

spans.text: Angelus bows slightly, as though she were curtsying to us.

units.rawText: Behind her, the ruined mechanical wings reassemble themselves, and then spread open — as a set of rotor blades that resemble a meat-grinder.
units.displayText: Behind her, the ruined mechanical wings reassemble themselves, and then spread open — as a set of rotor blades that resemble a meat-grinder.

spans.text: Behind her, the ruined mechanical wings reassemble themselves, and then spread open — as a set of rotor blades that resemble a meat-grinder.

units.rawText: Teaching you a lesson is well within my capabilities.
units.displayText: Teaching you a lesson is well within my capabilities.

spans.text: Teaching you a lesson is well within my capabilities.

units.rawText: She opens her eyes, and her gaze locks onto us—
units.displayText: She opens her eyes, and her gaze locks onto us—

spans.text: She opens her eyes, and her gaze locks onto us—

units.rawText: Look out!
units.displayText: Look out!

spans.text: Look out!

units.rawText: Sol pushes Croque and Antonina away with surprising speed.
units.displayText: Sol pushes Croque and Antonina away with surprising speed.

spans.text: Sol pushes Croque and Antonina away with surprising speed.

units.rawText: In the next moment, Angelus has appeared in front of her and the rotor blades chop Sol's arm to pieces.
units.displayText: In the next moment, Angelus has appeared in front of her and the rotor blades chop Sol's arm to pieces.

spans.text: In the next moment, Angelus has appeared in front of her and the rotor blades chop Sol's arm to pieces.

units.rawText: Oh? You have excellent instincts. Is your Base Command to protect your friends?
units.displayText: Oh? You have excellent instincts. Is your Base Command to protect your friends?

spans.text: Oh? You have excellent instincts. Is your Base Command to protect your friends?

units.rawText: Croque slams down with her shield, and Angelus instantly evades.
units.displayText: Croque slams down with her shield, and Angelus instantly evades.

spans.text: Croque slams down with her shield, and Angelus instantly evades.

units.rawText: Sol!
units.displayText: Sol!

spans.text: Sol!

units.rawText: Antonina helps Sol up, supporting her mangled body.
units.displayText: Antonina helps Sol up, supporting her mangled body.

spans.text: Antonina helps Sol up, supporting her mangled body.

units.rawText: The operands spewing from Sol's wounds are sucked away by the operand black hole in an instant. Sol breathes heavily and says nothing.
units.displayText: The operands spewing from Sol's wounds are sucked away by the operand black hole in an instant. Sol breathes heavily and says nothing.

spans.text: The operands spewing from Sol's wounds are sucked away by the operand black hole in an instant. Sol breathes heavily and says nothing.

units.rawText: She attempts to grab her sword with her other hand, but anyone can tell that she can no longer fight.
units.displayText: She attempts to grab her sword with her other hand, but anyone can tell that she can no longer fight.

spans.text: She attempts to grab her sword with her other hand, but anyone can tell that she can no longer fight.

units.rawText: Antonina, take the others and fall back!
units.displayText: Antonina, take the others and fall back!

spans.text: Antonina, take the others and fall back!

units.rawText: Are you kidding me, we came here to save you!
units.displayText: Are you kidding me, we came here to save you!

spans.text: Are you kidding me, we came here to save you!

units.rawText: Don't be so damn stubborn at a time like this! Run!!
units.displayText: Don't be so damn stubborn at a time like this! Run!!

spans.text: Don't be so damn stubborn at a time like this! Run!!

units.rawText: Aw, don't be in such a rush, none of you are getting away.
units.displayText: Aw, don't be in such a rush, none of you are getting away.

spans.text: Aw, don't be in such a rush, none of you are getting away.

units.rawText: After seeing how much you care for each other, I'll make it quick.
units.displayText: After seeing how much you care for each other, I'll make it quick.

spans.text: After seeing how much you care for each other, I'll make it quick.

units.rawText: —Starting with you.
units.displayText: —Starting with you.

spans.text: —Starting with you.

units.rawText: Angelus points her arrow at me again. There is no fear in my mind, and no panic. I am still thinking about how to buy more time for everyone's retreat, how to buy more time for Persicaria in the operand black hole.
units.displayText: Angelus points her arrow at me again. There is no fear in my mind, and no panic. I am still thinking about how to buy more time for everyone's retreat, how to buy more time for Persicaria in the operand black hole.

units.rawText: I know Antonina will be able to successfully lead the Dolls in a retreat, and I believe that Persicaria will be able to keep ENIAC from going out of control and emerge from the black hole.

units.rawText: Sorry, Professor.
units.displayText: Sorry, Professor.

units.rawText: Looks like I took a little too long.
units.displayText: Looks like I took a little too long.

spans.text: Looks like I took a little too long.

units.rawText: ...No, it's enough that you made it back.
units.displayText: ...No, it's enough that you made it back.

units.rawText: Yes, I'm back.
units.displayText: Yes, I'm back.

units.rawText: You'll surpass the imaginations of the Enigma Sector, of that professor, of all humanity...
units.displayText: You'll surpass the imaginations of the Enigma Sector, of that professor, of all humanity...
